hero.filename: Avenger being armed on HMS Illustrious (87) 1944.jpg
hero.title: File:Avenger being armed on HMS Illustrious (87) 1944.jpg
hero.artist: Lt. C. Trusler, Royal Navy official photographer
hero.credit: This photograph A 24250 comes from the collections of the Imperial War Museums.
hero.source: Avenger being armed on HMS Illustrious (87) 1944
hero.description: Bombing up a Royal Navy Grumman Avenger Mk.II aircraft of 832 or 845 Naval Air Squadron on the flight deck of the aircraft carrier HMS Illustrious (87) sailing in the Indian Ocean in readiness for the raid on Soerabaya, Java, in May 1944. The air strike against the Japanese held naval base was carried out by British, American, Australian, French and Dutch units. Several of the armourers are stood inside the aircraft's open bomb bay.

gallery.description:
The Royal Navy during the Second World War
Bombing up a Grumman Avenger aircraft on the flight deck of HMS ILLUSTRIOUS sailing in the Indian Ocean in readiness for the raid on Surabaya. The air strike against the Japanese held naval base was carried out by British, American, Australian, French and Dutch units. Several of the armourers are stood inside the aircraft's open bomb bay.
